user_story: As a guest, I want cancelling an already-cancelled booking to return a clear error so that duplicate cancellations are handled.

positive.title: Successful attempt to cancel a non-cancelled booking
steps: Attempt to cancel the same booking again.
positive.expected_result: The system returns a clear error message indicating that the booking has already been cancelled.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel a booking that does not exist
steps: Attempt to cancel a booking with a non-existent ID.
negative.expected_result: The system returns a clear error message indicating that the booking does not exist.

edge.title: Attempt to cancel a booking using an invalid ID format
steps: Cancel a booking using an invalid ID (e.g., special characters).
edge.expected_result: The system returns a clear error message indicating that the ID format is invalid.
